wiki.title: Jamie Wall (politician)
wiki.extract: James Richard "Jamie" Wall Jr. (born September 1971) is an American business consultant and Democratic politician from Green Bay, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 30th Senate district since 2025. Earlier in his career, Wall served as administrator of the Division of Economic Development in the Wisconsin Department of Commerce during Jim Doyle's first term as governor. He also ran unsuccessfully for U.S. House of Representatives in 2006 and 2012.
